A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ConTextTab research work, with 29 readable pages including Appendices A–C. Text, equations, tables, and rendered figures support reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v3 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, dataset-size analyses, and runtime measurements in Section 5 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix A, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and runtime measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same modality-specific embeddings, interleaved attention backbone, weight sharing, output heads, and binning, clustering, and ISAB alternatives. Training and inference procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain T4 pretraining, the same curriculum-training data, and 203 evaluation tasks across CARTE, OpenML-CC18, OpenML-CTR23, TabReD, and TALENT-Tiny. The dataset inventory in Tables 4–5 and synthetic runtime scenario in Appendix A.3 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 3 retain the same comparator rows, including TabPFN, TabICL, TabDPT, CARTE, boosted trees, RealMLP, TabM, AutoGluon, and supplementary baselines. Comparator membership also matches in the runtime and semantic-encoder experiments.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain the same training budgets, preprocessing, 70/10/20 splits, evaluation metrics, default 8192-row context, and eight-fold bagging. No stated experimental setting or evaluation design changes.

E4.justification: The semantic, model-size, context-size, training-data, clipping, fine-tuning, and architectural ablations are retained in Section 5.1, Table 2, and Appendix A. Dataset-size analyses, runtime comparisons, and the contamination check also retain the same evidence.

E5.justification: The Wilcoxon tests, critical-difference diagrams, bootstrapped 80% confidence bands in Figure 4, and five-repeat runtime averaging in Appendix A.3 are unchanged. No repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains ConTextTab's CARTE accuracy of 76.9%, soft-clipped R² of 72.4%, and rank of 1.55. Changes such as 2.5 to 2.50 in Table 1 and 4.7 to 4.70 in Table 3 are equivalent formatting.

T1.justification: The soft-binning definition, clustering loss in Equation 1, ISAB construction in Equation 2, and associated mathematical arguments are unchanged. Mathematical spacing differences do not alter definitions or reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: semantic-aware table-native ICL trained on real data, competitive performance across broader benchmarks, and advantages on CARTE and in the low-data regime.

C2.justification: Sections 5–6 and Appendix A preserve the interpretations and limitations concerning large-dataset scaling, possible contamination, insufficient semantic diversity, and limited benefits from target-semantic clustering. No substantive explanation or applicability qualification changes.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the code/checkpoint repository pointer from SAP-samples/contexttab to SAP-samples/sap-rpt-1-oss. This revises access information; implementation, hyperparameter, and hardware disclosures otherwise match. The PDFs do not establish any change in the repository assets themselves.

R1.justification: The same 43 works and research positioning are retained. Reference 33 updates an author's name, while Reference 37 updates MiniLM capitalization and adds its arXiv identifier; these are metadata edits to existing citations.

P1.justification: Limited editorial changes include correcting 'vanishinlgy' to 'vanishingly', updating reference metadata, and replacing 'Preprint. Under review.' with the NeurIPS 2025 conference footer. Section order, paragraph structure, and substantive wording remain intact.

P2.justification: Tables 1 and 3 add trailing zeros to several rank entries, with small typography and spacing adjustments. Figures 1–12, table structures and placement, and the overall page layout are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 updates publication and repository information, fixes minor textual and bibliographic details, and regularizes table decimals. The methods, empirical support, statistical reporting, explanations, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. These small edits leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged; the PDFs show no additional reproducibility benefit beyond the revised repository pointer.
